# nrvna

> Unix-like primitives for durable local inference.

nrvna is not a chat API or agent framework. `wrk` publishes an independent
job, `nrvnad` processes one workspace with one model, and `flw` reads status or
terminal artifacts. Context does not carry between jobs. `--parent` records
lineage only. No HTTP server or message broker is required.

## Start

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sanmathigb/nrvna/main/README.md): Product contract, verified first run, boundaries, and applications.
- [Documentation map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sanmathigb/nrvna/main/DOCUMENTATION.md): Shortest path to the right human or agent guide.
- [Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sanmathigb/nrvna/main/QUICKSTART.md): Build and complete the first durable inference job.
- [Agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sanmathigb/nrvna/main/AGENTS.md): Operational contract for coding agents and scripts.

## Understand and build

- [Domain language](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sanmathigb/nrvna/main/CONTEXT.md): Canonical job, workspace, state, artifact, and lifecycle terms.
- [Advanced patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sanmathigb/nrvna/main/ADVANCED.md): Batches, tags, explicit context transfer, and multiple models.
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sanmathigb/nrvna/main/CONFIGURATION.md): Runtime, model, logging, and application settings.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sanmathigb/nrvna/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): Filesystem state machine, daemon lifecycle, and implementation ownership.

## Applications

- [imgsrch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sanmathigb/nrvna/main/apps/imgsrch/README.md): Local screenshot and image search.
- [imgsrch agent install](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sanmathigb/nrvna/main/apps/imgsrch/INSTALL.md): Cold-agent installation runbook.
- [bckbrnr](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sanmathigb/nrvna/main/apps/bckbrnr/README.md): macOS menu-bar prompt work with file results.

## Contract priority

For command syntax, use `wrk --help`, `nrvnad --help`, and `flw --help` from
the installed version. For implementation work, the authoritative filesystem
and lifecycle contracts are `include/nrvna/contract.hpp` and
`include/nrvna/lifecycle.hpp`.
